[P2] Reconcile provisional completion data across collection phases

The timestamp-enrichment problem remains for invocation ends. Partial collection can retain a wrapper failure at 40 ms before timeout history arrives; final collection then replaces it with native timeout completion at 30 ms. The base coordinator rejects both the narrowed `endedAtMs` and the changed outcome, quarantining successfully drained work. Preserve provisional wrapper data separately and explicitly reconcile service enrichment. Add a partial-to-final regression where native timeout precedes wrapper exit and its history arrives during retirement.
